name: Choco Mints | Melted Diamond Live Resin Vaporizer | 1.0g (Reload)
description: Welcome to the next generation of vaping. Clocking in at up to 95% potency, our live resin melted diamonds pair perfectly with our new hardware, designed to create ultra big clouds and super smooth hits. Choco Mints Choco Mints blends rich chocolate, and cool peppermint into a festive holiday treat. This limited-time hybrid delivers cozy, uplifting effects that turn any moment into a winter celebration.
